paper.title_en: Shell crossing and the dynamical formation of thin shells in the collapse of self-gravitating relativistic dust
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that shell crossing in the collapse of self-gravitating relativistic dust in spherical symmetry can be understood as dynamical formation of a thin shell of dust. More precisely, we consider the spherically symmetric Einstein-dust system in double null coordinates (E-d), for which first singularities with area radius bounded away from zero are known as 'shell crossing' singularities. We show that there exists a weak solution of (E-d), in which a thin shell of dust forms, extending beyond any 'non-degenerate' first shell crossing singularity of a smooth 'collapsing' solution of (E-d). This local extension is unique in the class of piecewise smooth solutions of (E-d) satisfying a 'determinism condition'. We then consider the physical problem of smooth data for (E-d) on an initial hypersurface diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^3$, containing a collapsing dust cloud. We show that, for generic such initial data, there exists a maximal globally hyperbolic piecewise smooth development satisfying a 'propagation condition' (stronger than the determinism condition). The development may contain an arbitrary (finite) number of thin shells which can moreover merge. All shell crossing singularities are 'resolved' and the area radius extends continuously to zero at any first singularity of the maximal development. We note that, for an open set of initial data in the smooth topology, as shown by Christodoulou, a Cauchy horizon emanates from a central 'shell-focussing' singularity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在球对称爱因斯坦-尘埃系统的双零坐标框架下研究壳穿越奇点的动力学解析，构造了含薄壳的弱解并证明分段光滑极大双曲发展的存在性与唯一性，属于广义相对论基础中关于奇点与柯西视界的前沿理论问题，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强。
decision.title_zh: 自引力相对论尘埃坍缩中壳穿越与薄壳的动力学形成
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们证明：球对称自引力相对论尘埃坍缩中的壳穿越可以理解为尘埃薄壳的动力学形成。更确切地说，我们考虑双零坐标下的球对称爱因斯坦-尘埃系统（E-d），其中面积半径远离零而出现的第一类奇点被称为“壳穿越”奇点。我们证明（E-d）存在一个弱解，其中形成了一个尘埃薄壳，并延伸到（E-d）某个光滑“坍缩”解的任意“非退化”第一壳穿越奇点之外。这一局部延伸在满足“确定性条件”的（E-d）分段光滑解类中是唯一的。随后我们考虑（E-d）在微分同胚于 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 的初始超曲面上的光滑数据这一物理问题，该数据包含一个坍缩的尘埃云。我们证明，对于一般的此类初始数据，存在满足“传播条件”（强于确定性条件）的极大整体双曲分段光滑发展。该发展可以包含任意（有限）数量的薄壳，且这些薄壳还可以合并。所有壳穿越奇点都被“解决”，并且面积半径在极大发展的任意第一奇点处连续地延伸至零。我们注意到，对于光滑拓扑下的一个开集初始数据，正如 Christodoulou 所证明的，一个柯西视界从中心“壳聚焦”奇点发出。
